review:
A 20-line underwater game with lots going on in the base game – random features can trigger on any spin.

The free spins are built around roaming wilds and a growing multiplier: wilds move across the reels while the multiplier climbs, so a long bonus with busy wilds can build towards the 10,000x max. An older game, but popular enough to get two sequels. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
